title: get health endpoint returns service and dependency status
description: Verify that GET /health returns HTTP 200 with service status and database and redis checks marked ok when all dependencies are operational.

title: get livez endpoint returns service liveness status
description: Verify that GET /livez returns HTTP 200 with service liveness status indicating the instance is ready.

title: get services endpoint returns active dental services with valid channel filter
description: Verify that GET /api/services returns HTTP 200 with a list of active dental services and correctly filters results when channel query parameter is clinic or van.

title: get services endpoint returns 400 for invalid channel parameter
description: Verify that GET /api/services with an invalid channel query parameter returns HTTP 400 with a validation error.

title: post van coverage check returns coverage status for valid gps coordinates
description: Verify that POST /api/public/van/coverage-check with valid latitude and longitude returns HTTP 200 with isCovered, coordinates, assignedVan, message, and inputType gps.

title: post van coverage check returns 400 for malformed coordinates
description: Verify that POST /api/public/van/coverage-check with malformed or invalid coordinates returns HTTP 400 with a validation error.

title: post auth check email returns email existence status
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/check-email returns HTTP 200 with exists true and role patient for existing emails, and exists false for new emails.

title: post auth register creates new patient account with valid data
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/register with unique email and valid profile details returns HTTP 201 with accessToken, refreshToken, and user information.

title: post auth login authenticates user with valid credentials
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/login with valid email and password returns HTTP 200 with accessToken, refreshToken, and user details.

title: post auth refresh rotates refresh token and issues new tokens
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/refresh with a valid refreshToken returns HTTP 200 with new accessToken and refreshToken, and invalid or expired tokens return HTTP 401.

title: get and put patient profile endpoint retrieves and updates patient details
description: Authenticate via POST /api/auth/login (test@pavdental.com / Password123!), extract user.id and accessToken, then verify GET /api/patients/{user.id}/profile returns HTTP 200 and PUT /api/patients/{user.id}/profile with firstName, lastName, city, postcode returns HTTP 200.

title: get patient odontogram and treatment plans endpoints return clinical records
description: Authenticate via POST /api/auth/login (test@pavdental.com / Password123!), extract user.id and accessToken, then verify GET /api/patients/{user.id}/odontogram and GET /api/patients/{user.id}/plans both return HTTP 200 with JSON arrays.

title: get booking slots endpoint returns available appointment time slots
description: Authenticate via POST /api/auth/login (test@pavdental.com / Password123!), then verify GET /api/booking/slots?date=2026-10-25&channel=clinic with Bearer accessToken returns HTTP 200 with a non-empty list of slots containing id, startTimeUtc, endTimeUtc, available, and durationMinutes.

title: get booking appointments endpoint lists patient appointments
description: Authenticate via POST /api/auth/login (test@pavdental.com / Password123!), then verify GET /api/booking/appointments with Bearer accessToken returns HTTP 200 with a JSON array of appointments.

title: get and post messages endpoints list threads and create new clinical message thread
description: Authenticate via POST /api/auth/login (test@pavdental.com / Password123!), verify GET /api/messages returns HTTP 200 with message threads, and POST /api/messages with {"subject":"Post-visit question","body":"Is mild sensitivity normal?","recipientName":"Pav Dental Clinical Team"} returns HTTP 201.

title: get financing endpoint returns pre approved limit and applications
description: Authenticate via POST /api/auth/login (test@pavdental.com / Password123!), then verify GET /api/financing returns HTTP 200 with preApprovedLimitPence, aprPercent, and applications array.

title: post financing apply creates 0 percent apr bnpl financing application
description: Authenticate via POST /api/auth/login (test@pavdental.com / Password123!), then verify POST /api/financing/apply with {"treatmentCostPence":120000,"durationMonths":12} returns HTTP 201 with status pre_approved, monthlyPence 10000, and agreementRef.

title: get rewards endpoint returns smile points balance and reward catalog
description: Authenticate via POST /api/auth/login (test@pavdental.com / Password123!), then verify GET /api/rewards returns HTTP 200 with pointsBalance, streakDays, nextTierPoints, catalog array, and redemptions array.

title: get rewards insights and post brushing log update oral health metrics
description: Authenticate via POST /api/auth/login (test@pavdental.com / Password123!), verify GET /api/rewards/insights returns HTTP 200 with plaqueIndexPercent and weeklyBrushing, and POST /api/rewards/brushing-log with {"day":"Sun","session":"pm","durationSec":120} returns HTTP 200 with updated pointsBalance.

title: post consents grant and get consents current manage gdpr patient consents
description: Authenticate via POST /api/auth/login (test@pavdental.com / Password123!), verify POST /api/consents/grant with {"consentType":"marketing_communications","lawfulBasis":"consent"} returns HTTP 201 with isGranted true, and GET /api/consents/current returns HTTP 200 with active consent records.
